h1: Custom 32 oz Koozies for Large Cans & Bottles
metaDescription: Order custom 32 oz koozies for large cans and bottles. Perfect for events and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 32 oz koozies are designed to fit oversized cans and bottles, making them ideal for outdoor events, tailgates, and summer promotions. Unlike standard koozies, these accommodate larger beverages while keeping drinks cold. Options include neoprene sleeves or vacuum-insulated holders, with full-color imprinting available. Perfect for safety managers or marketing directors looking for a practical giveaway that stands out.
heroAltText: Custom 32 oz koozies in neoprene and stainless steel for large cans and bottles
